name: Build-A-Bully
source:
When 18-year-old Charity Caldwell dies in what seems to be a tragic accident, the small town of Rabbithole Hills is shocked.

But not as shocked as Denver is when the dripping pink specter floats down through her ceiling, demanding she build her a perfect new body.

Help perfect victim Denver try to impress her favorite tormentor with the hottest, sexiest, baddest new body she could possibly have. Sure, it won't be as good as her old one, but you'll get it as close to perfect as possible, right? Just for her?

[From [url=https://professionald.itch.io/build-a-bully]itch.io[/url]]
